**✨ Feature release** · Obsidian 1.11.4+ · desktop & mobile

You can now choose the font and the font size of the whole M.I.L.A interface in Settings — everything scales together, or stays exactly as Obsidian by default.

### 🌟 Highlights
- **Interface font**: pick any CSS font family for the whole M.I.L.A UI (Settings › Chat › Appearance). Leave it empty to keep Obsidian's font.
- **Interface font size**: set a base size in pixels (e.g. `15` or `16`) and messages, lists and menus all scale with it. Leave it empty to keep Obsidian's size.

### 🔧 Improvements
- The settings screen shows the same chosen font, so you see exactly what the chat will look like.

### ⚠️ Compatibility
- Reload Obsidian after updating. Settings migrate automatically.
